official_fifo_source.lines: 339-340, 436-474: fixed pipe cursor; next head considered only when predecessor retires; external release gates head

cpu_measurement_scope: Python analyzer process_time only; Git byte-read subprocess CPU not separately measured. Outer wall includes these reads and is bounded to 60 s.
interpretation_limits: Bounds are plan-specific necessary computation/FIFO constraints, not global optimal values or execution-legality proofs.
Actual adjacent same-pipe operations are reconstructed from observed start order and verified to be non-overlapping; latent Step3 memory-dependency edges were not regenerated.
Transfer waiting sums can overlap and are not removable makespan. Critical release equality is a necessary constraint in this observed queue, not proof of a counterfactual performance gain.
